tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category that has at least one archived win, with win count, net profit and the last settlement time. Use the `key` value as the `category` filter of searchSettledWins. No API key needed.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_markets" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_settled_wins" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search KalshiSpy's archive of settled Kalshi markets where its roster of ID-verified, high-profit Kalshi traders held the WINNING side with positive net realize…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_markets, search_settled_wins · Private data: search_markets, search_settled_wins, get_settled_win, list_categories, get_stats · Public sink: search_markets.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_markets, search_settled_wins · Private data: search_markets, search_settled_wins, get_settled_win, list_categories, get_stats · Public sink: search_markets

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
